title: Purpleboy
description: Purpleboy is a story full of symbolism. A fable based on personal memory. An elegantly realised and warming tale of self-discovery, acceptance and familial love. Born with an improbable bouffant in his parents garden, Oscar is on a search for identity in an authoritarian and parochial society.
music: Christophe Petchanatz Five colourful female figures swim a fertility dance
while downstream five flippered frogmen power through the pondweed to reach them. “The film addresses the meaning of manhood in a world of fully emancipated women” say the directors
although they add “we do not take this subject too seriously”.
